sentences.text: This end-of-well review covers wellbore 15/9-F-4 on the Volve field in the Norwegian North Sea.

It was written without access to the field data tools, so it states no measured figures: hole sizes, depths, dates, durations, rates and volumes are deliberately omitted rather than estimated from memory.
Real-time curve statistics are not summarised here and should not be read into this review.

The hole-section breakdown, with each section's hole size, start and end depths, new hole drilled and casing shoe depths, must be taken from the wellbore's section records before this review is issued.
Each section should be checked for its drilling rate and for the casing shoe that closed it, so that the section record can be reconciled against the casing program.
Total activity hours, lost hours by tier and code, and the lost-time share for the well and for each section must be computed from the activity log rather than quoted here.
Lost-time activities should be reviewed against their operation codes so that the dominant causes of non-productive time are identified with evidence.
The drilling, completion and any intervention campaigns on the well should be listed with their start and end dates, active days and operation phase.
Report coverage, including the first and last report dates, any before-spud or flagged reports, and the total depth reached, should be confirmed against the daily report archive.
Before issue, populate every figure in this review from the field data and attach the supporting evidence identifiers to each claim.
Carry forward to the next well in the campaign any lessons on section sequencing and on the causes of lost time identified in the completed analysis.
